description.content: Approved vendor-home BFF operation (operationId getVendorHome). Composes vendor context, booking home-summary (owners/admins only), and capacity widgets. Membership is resolved via Vendor operational-access; unrelated callers receive 403. When nextAction is not OPEN_VENDOR_DASHBOARD, home and capacity operational data are omitted. Optional capacity dependency failures return 200 with meta.partialData and unavailableSections. Core identity/home-summary failures return 4xx/5xx. No /vendors/{vendorId}/home alias is exposed; this /partner/{vendorId}/manager/home path is the stable public route.

description.content: Partner BFF client-facing contracts. Requests use the platform access-token authorizer; downstream domain calls use the platform internal bearer from SSM, never the user token. GET /partner/{vendorId}/manager/home is the approved vendor-home dashboard composition surface (operationId getVendorHome). The previous sections-based manager-home payload is replaced by the stable vendor/home/capacity/meta contract documented below.
